amendments: This authorization continues candidate-first acceptance; no merged-main claim.
New questions preserve the three original capability classes; old failed questions are not resent, old unsubmitted Q3 remains unsubmitted.
Writer changed from K3 to the authorized existing GLM. Same-provider writer and judge are not fully independent financial QC.
Proxy uses tested durable dispatch accounting and read1 streaming; model whitelist extends to the pinned flash judge. No K3 temperature stripping.
No simultaneous #75 and L6 paid execution; #75 requests and L6 requests remain separate.
